v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui sanctum Ioánnem Confessórem tuum atque Doctórem perféctæ sui abnegatiónis et Crucis amatórem exímium effecísti: concéde; ut, eius imitatióni iúgiter inhæréntes, glóriam assequámur ætérnam.
text.en: O God, who didst give to blessed John, thy Confessor and Doctor, grace to shew forth a singular love of perfect self-denial and of bearing thy Cross: grant, we beseech thee; that we, cleaving steadfastly to his pattern, may attain to everlasting glory.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Adésto, Dómine, supplicatiónibus nostris: ut, qui ex iniquitáte nostra reos nos esse cognóscimus, beáti Chrysógoni Mártyris tui intercessióne liberémur.
text.en: Give ear, O Lord, unto our prayers, and grant that we who acknowledge ourselves guilty through our own iniquity, may be delivered at the petition of thy blessed Martyr Chrysogonus.

office.title: S. Joannis a Cruce Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
